results.prop: S2m mutation: a freshness of 5 s (the first design) violates P2 at the declared worst case
results.formula: expect counterexample

results.prop: S2hs scope: beyond the 32 s bound a drone stopped behind the bars before the CR, with no claim heard, is released by the t_occ_max fallback
results.formula: expect counterexample (claims S1, S4 cover it when heard)

results.prop: S2b mutation: no latch input in the band of a FRONT-only echo (round 2, F1) violates P2
results.formula: expect counterexample

results.prop: S3 evidence order: a status older than a later fix placing the drone possibly in the CR never excludes it
results.formula: randomized: last accepted fix in the CR with t_tx > status t_tx -> not excluded

results.prop: S3m mutation: without the evidence order the stale status excludes the drone
results.formula: expect violation

results.prop: S4 silence and death: a claim stands while the drone is silent for less than t_silent_gate_s, the receiver hears nobody, or it was last heard in the exclusion zone; a dead drone last heard outside it holds none
results.formula: randomized over silence durations up to a day

results.prop: S4b mutation: rule D reading the zone from the pruned fix list (round 8 code) releases a claim of a hull at the gate
results.formula: expect violation

results.prop: S4m mutation: a short silence releasing a claim is detected
results.formula: expect violation

results.prop: S5 text search: no acoustic or status name in the relation loop of GatePerception.update (does not see indirect paths)
results.formula: text: the relation loop and decision of GatePerception.update

results.prop: S6 drones at abreast queue points are never FRONT-only targets of each other (n=2,3, tolerances; only those points)
results.formula: enumeration over queue points, tolerances, heading tolerance

results.prop: S7 verified passage: never verified with the true centre inside the CR grown by R_OUT, a blocked drone never verifies
results.formula: randomized: fit error, DVL scale and dropouts, blocked drones

results.prop: S9 sender rule: a true centre in the CR (estimate within the declared navigation error) is in the keep-out box, and inside the box the report is a claim for every history
results.formula: randomized + enumeration of passage.report_phase

results.prop: S9m mutation: a box without the navigation-error margin leaves an occupant outside
results.formula: expect violation

results.prop: S8 freshness deployed by GatePerception per layout: positive and below the shortest time from the queue to the CR at the speed bound
results.formula: 0 < status_fresh_s <= (|queue_s| - CR - R_OUT - queue_tol - nav_err) / v_bound - latency

results.prop: S6b no relation implies latch input (real class, no beacon): a FRONT-only echo anywhere in the band makes no relation and the latch is BUSY
results.formula: randomized over the band

results.prop: S11 a silence shorter than t_silent_gate_s or a stale report never discards a corridor echo, nor excludes a drone from the exit evaluation
results.formula: randomized: no fresh evidence -> no_fleet_drone false and status_excluded false

results.prop: S11m mutation: letting a silence of status_fresh_s exclude a drone discards the echo
results.formula: expect violation

results.prop: S12 the exclusion zone: a hull that fails outside it never enters the obstruction volume of the gate
results.formula: Z3: outside E and inside O at some t >= 0 is unsat

results.prop: S12m mutation: the zone without the coast term misses hulls
results.formula: expect violation

results.prop: S12l mutation: the zone without the rise lag misses hulls
results.formula: expect violation
